content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00049 When the RTE is required to activate an OsTask due to being triggered by an RTE- Event (e.g. DataReceivedEvent ) where the OsTask is referenced by an RtePre- decessorOsTaskRef or an RteSuccessorOsTaskRef and is not the ultimate pre- decessor OsTask in the chain, the RTE shall activate that OsTask ’s ultimate RtePre- decessorOsTaskRef instead of the OsTask it should have normally activated.

The RTE shall activate the chaining OsTask (defined by RtePre- decessorOsTaskRef ) instead the chained OsTask ( RteSuccessorOsTaskRef ) if the RTE needs to activate an OsTask to activate ExecutableEntity s.

When the RTE is required to activate an OsTask due to being trig- gered by an RTEEvent (e.g. DataReceivedEvent ) where the OsTask is referenced by an RtePredecessorOsTaskRef or an RteSuccessorOsTaskRef and is not the ultimate predecessor OsTask in the chain, the RTE shall activate that OsTask 's ul- timate RtePredecessorOsTaskRef instead of the OsTask it should have normally activated.

When the RTE is required to activate an OsTask due to being trig- gered by an RTEEvent (e.g. DataReceivedEvent ) where the OsTask is referenced by an RtePredecessorOsTaskRef or an RteSuccessorOsTaskRef and is not the ultimate predecessor OsTask in the chain, the RTE shall activate that OsTask 's ul- timate RtePredecessorOsTaskRef instead of the OsTask it should have normally activated.
